items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1964-04-25
items.q: One day, Bernice has come down to the house, and we organized a bunch of the yard.

ctx.x: I don't mean for money. I don't mean in your band. I mean just for fun. When was the last time you played the drums for fun?
Played on tin pan for that, yeah. One day, Bernice has come down to the house, and we organized a bunch of the yard.
Can you play on the table like this? Do you do this much? Yeah. Play something for us. Tip된 stuff with stuff
